graphNodes.title: PoolOS v2 - AI Pool Training Platform
graphNodes.summary: AI-powered pool billiards training platform with coach intelligence, drill libraries, and performance tracking for mobile (iOS/Android) built with Flutter.
graphNodes.languageNote: Flutter mobile app using Dart, with Supabase backend for authentication and database.

graphNodes.title: PoolOS v2 MVP Specification
graphNodes.summary: Complete MVP specification defining product vision, domain architecture (Knowledge/Evidence/Intelligence/Experience), player journey, data models, and technical decisions for the AI pool training platform.
graphNodes.languageNote: Core specification document establishing the AI pool training platform requirements.

graphNodes.title: Knowledge Domain
graphNodes.summary: Domain covering teachable pool content: techniques, drills, skills, learning paths, mistake analysis, and video mappings. Accessible to all players regardless of rank.
graphNodes.languageNote: One of four core domains in PoolOS v2 architecture.

graphNodes.title: Evidence Domain
graphNodes.summary: Domain covering observed player data: sessions, matches, racks, shots, events, and readiness metrics. Source of truth for all performance data.
graphNodes.languageNote: One of four core domains in PoolOS v2 architecture - stores actual player data.

graphNodes.title: Intelligence Domain (Coach Engine)
graphNodes.summary: Domain for AI-powered analysis and recommendations. Coach engine reads evidence, generates insights with evidence+reason+action, and acts as navigation engine. Never stores or modifies data.
graphNodes.languageNote: One of four core domains - the AI brain of PoolOS v2.

graphNodes.title: Experience Domain (UI Layer)
graphNodes.summary: Domain covering user-facing screens, components, and navigation. Coach is the center of the application experience. All user interactions flow through this domain.
graphNodes.languageNote: One of four core domains - the presentation layer of PoolOS v2.

graphNodes.title: Coach Engine Principles
graphNodes.summary: Core principles: Coach NEVER stores data, modifies data, generates fake statistics, or shows recommendations without evidence. Coach ALWAYS reads from Statistics Engine, provides Evidence+Reason+Action, acts as Navigation Engine, and shows Data Confidence level.
graphNodes.languageNote: Fundamental rules governing Coach AI behavior.

graphNodes.title: Player Levels (Rank System)
graphNodes.summary: Six-tier ranking system: Beginner (Chưa từng chơi) → K (no fundamentals) → I (basic technique, 2-3 ball runs) → H (club player, has tactics) → G (good club player, wins small tournaments) → F (strong player, competitive).
graphNodes.languageNote: Player progression system in PoolOS v2.

graphNodes.title: Session Data Model
graphNodes.summary: Complete session model capturing: player, date, type (practice/tournament/casual), pre-match context (arrival, warmup), readiness, matches, post-match context (fatigue, mental state, self-rating), notes, and AI-generated coach review.
graphNodes.languageNote: Core data entity for recording practice or match sessions.

graphNodes.title: Shot Data Model
graphNodes.summary: Detailed shot recording: shotType (pot/safety/break/jump/kick/bank/combo/push_out/masse), difficulty, spinUsed, result, events (scratch/foul/double_kiss/easy_miss/wrong_angle/etc), confidence, and challenge (practice mode).
graphNodes.languageNote: Granular shot-level data capture for performance analysis.

graphNodes.title: Coach Recommendation Data Model
graphNodes.summary: AI-generated recommendation structure: observation, evidence summary, reason, dataConfidence, recommendation with expectedResult, drillSuggestions, actionLabel, actionRoute for navigation, priority (critical/blocking/improvement/knowledge/positive), and status.
graphNodes.languageNote: Structured format for Coach AI recommendations with navigation integration.

graphNodes.title: Training Center
graphNodes.summary: Central hub for pool training with four main modules: AI Learning Path (weekly personalized recommendations), Drill Library (categorized drills), Knowledge (educational content), and Skill Certification (ability tests). Training Center is for practice ONLY - no match recording.
graphNodes.languageNote: Main training feature module of PoolOS v2.

graphNodes.title: AI Learning Path
graphNodes.summary: Weekly AI-generated learning recommendations. AI suggests personalized drills based on player profile, recent performance, and weaknesses. User can Follow AI recommendation or Skip to choose own drills. AI only recommends - never restricts.
graphNodes.languageNote: AI-powered learning plan feature within Training Center.

graphNodes.title: Drill Library
graphNodes.summary: Complete library of pool training drills organized by difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert) and category (Potting, Position, Safety, Kick, Jump, Masse, Bridge, Cue Ball, Mental). Two tabs: Recommended (from AI) and All Drills. All drills visible to all users - no rank lock.
graphNodes.languageNote: Core drill repository with categorization and filtering.

graphNodes.title: Drill Level System
graphNodes.summary: Each drill has 5 levels (Lv1-Lv5) with progressive unlocking. Must complete Lv2 to unlock Lv3, etc. Level completion requires passing criteria (e.g., 10 attempts with 8 successes). NO manual 'Complete' button - app auto-evaluates.
graphNodes.languageNote: Gamified drill progression system with mandatory sequential unlocking.

graphNodes.title: Knowledge Library
graphNodes.summary: Educational content library independent from drills. Contains knowledge about pool techniques organized by category (Cue Ball, Spin, Kick, Jump, Masse, Bank, Safety, Bridge, Psychology, Strategy, Equipment). NOT locked by rank - even Beginner players can access advanced knowledge. Bidirectional link with drills.
graphNodes.languageNote: Free-form educational content accessible to all skill levels.

graphNodes.title: Skill Certification
graphNodes.summary: Ability tests to measure skill levels (Stop Shot Test, Position Test, Follow Test, Draw Test). NOT for unlocking drills or confirming level completion. ONLY for measuring skill and tracking progress. Available anytime to all players.
graphNodes.languageNote: Optional skill assessment feature for self-evaluation.

graphNodes.title: AI Recommendation Algorithm
graphNodes.summary: Three-factor scoring for drill recommendations: Interest Match (40%) based on onboarding preferences, Performance Need (30%) based on identified weaknesses, Rank Appropriate (30%) based on player level. Score >70 indicates recommended status.
graphNodes.languageNote: Formula: RECOMMENDATION_SCORE = (Interest_Match x 0.4) + (Performance_Need x 0.3) + (Rank_Appropriate x 0.3)

graphNodes.title: Vision Auto Recording System
graphNodes.summary: AI-powered automatic shot detection using computer vision (TensorFlow Lite/MediaPipe). Camera detects table, balls, and automatically records shots without manual input. Includes ball tracking, pot detection, miss detection, and position accuracy scoring. Planned for v3.0 with fallback to manual mode.
graphNodes.languageNote: Phase 2 (v3.0) feature for automatic AI-powered shot detection.

graphNodes.title: Vision Recording Architecture
graphNodes.summary: Camera → Vision Engine (ML Model) → Shot Detector → Shot Event Processor (Ball/Pot/Miss/Position Detection) → Training Session Recorder (Drill Manager, Shot Store, Stats Update, Coach Input). Performance target: 30 FPS, <100ms latency, <15% battery/hour.
graphNodes.languageNote: System architecture for computer vision shot detection.

graphNodes.title: Flutter Framework
graphNodes.summary: Flutter 3.44.6 with Dart 3.12 for cross-platform mobile development (iOS/Android). Uses Material Design 3 with custom components.
graphNodes.languageNote: Primary development framework.

graphNodes.title: Riverpod State Management
graphNodes.summary: flutter_riverpod ^2.6.1 and riverpod_annotation ^2.6.1 for reactive state management with code generation support.
graphNodes.languageNote: State management solution with annotations for code generation.

graphNodes.title: GoRouter Navigation
graphNodes.summary: go_router ^14.8.1 for declarative routing and navigation in the Flutter app.
graphNodes.languageNote: Navigation library for Flutter with declarative routing.

graphNodes.title: Supabase Backend
graphNodes.summary: supabase_flutter ^2.8.2 for authentication, database (PostgreSQL), and edge functions. Row-level security ensures players can only access their own data.
graphNodes.languageNote: Backend-as-a-Service for authentication, database, and serverless functions.

graphNodes.title: Dart Analysis Options
graphNodes.summary: Flutter analysis configuration using flutter_lints recommended set for enforcing good coding practices. Located in analysis_options.yaml.
graphNodes.languageNote: Dart analyzer configuration for code quality enforcement.
